conviction_note: Session settled as amc (release ~17:15 CET on 24 Nov, after the GPW close), so the real window is close 24 Nov -> close 25 Nov. Q3 numbers are new (CD Projekt does not pre-release and gives no guidance). Two thin estimate feeds put the bar at EPS ~1.04 / revenue ~PLN 211m, which looks low against company-stated Q3 demand signals and a name that beat EPS in 7 of its last 10 quarters. But those beats have mostly been met with small or negative two-day moves, and Q2's beat came largely from lumpy licensing. So: a modest lean up (p_up 55) on a 4% move. The findings sum to +0.7 and the scaled number is +0.4; neither was fitted to the other.

Company schedule: Q3 2026 content released ~5:15 PM CET on 24 Nov, audio webcast at 5:30 PM CET

findings.finding: The company itself stated that Cyberpunk 2077's Steam CCU passed 100k in the first week of July 2026, the highest since October 2023, and that Phantom Liberty crossed 15m copies in September. That points to a strong Q3 back catalogue against a consensus (revenue ~PLN 211m, EPS 1.04) that sits below Q2's PLN 244m revenue / PLN 142.9m profit and far below Q3 2025's PLN 349m / PLN 193.5m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Per TipRanks, EPS beats have been met with small or negative two-day moves: Q2 2026 1.43 vs 1.06, +0.65%; Q3 2025 1.92 vs 0.71, +2.59%; Q4 2025 2.60 vs 0.82, +4.22%; Q4 2024 2.20 vs 0.70, -7.97%; Q3 2024 0.78 vs 0.54, -4.41%. This name often sells its beats.
findings.why_not_priced: The bar comes from three or four analysts on thin feeds that have under-called CDR in 7 of the last 10 quarters (TipRanks history). If it had been priced, the consensus would sit nearer Q2's run-rate than PLN 104m net. The sell-off of the last five days (-5.45%) is attributed to GTA VI profit-taking, not to Q3 doubts. That said, a habitual beat is itself partly expected, which is why the size is small.
findings.independence: BNP Paribas BM (2 Nov) rates CDR positively but gives no Q3 number, https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/165834,listopadowa-dziesiatka-czyli-inwestycyjne-typy-bnp-paribas-bm. Q2 profit beat the PAP consensus by 44%: https://www.biznesradar.pl/prognozy/CD-PROJEKT

findings.finding: The release and call will likely give the first company figures on Witcher 3 Remastered and on Q4 trading after Edgerunners 2. Third-party data point up: Alinea estimates ~130k copies in one day and 2.4m DAU; Erste forecasts ~3m copies / PLN 100-125m by year-end; Cyberpunk's Steam CCU peaked above 187k in October. The CFO said these items should deliver the PLN 273m H2 profit needed for the incentive tranche.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean history. The remaster launch itself moved the stock -0.55% on 1 Oct (Strefa Inwestorów). Company sales milestones (Cyberpunk 35m in Q3 2025) came with a +2.6% two-day reaction.
findings.original_quote: "Szacujemy sprzedaż na poziomie około 3 mln egzemplarzy w okresie od 29 września do końca 2026 roku." (Erste, Krzysztof Tkocz; https://strefainwestorow.pl/gaming/cdprojekt-akcje-wiedzmin3-remaster-steam-wyniki) - 'We estimate sales of about 3m copies from 29 September to the end of 2026.'
findings.why_not_priced: The Steam and Alinea data are public, but no company copy count or Q4-to-date figure exists yet. Noble's analyst said the remaster is not a key 2026 driver ('brakuje namacalnych driverów wynikowych'), so part of the sell side has not credited it. If it were priced, the stock would not have given back 5.7% in the days before the print. Early Steam reviews were mixed (64-68%), which limits the size.
findings.independence: BNP Paribas BM: Edgerunners 2 'mocno pozytywnie wpłynął w październiku na sprzedaż i liczbę graczy' (strongly lifted sales and player numbers in October), https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/165834,listopadowa-dziesiatka-czyli-inwestycyjne-typy-bnp-paribas-bm

findings.finding: The CFO said most of H1's PLN 94.8m IP licensing was booked in Q2, which 'was rather spectacular'. Q2's PLN 142.9m profit was therefore inflated by a lumpy line, and Q3 licensing is likely to fall back.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The licensing line is new in 2026 and has no reaction history. The Q2 beat built on it moved the stock only +0.65% over two days.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the consensus of PLN 211m revenue already sits below Q2's PLN 244m. It is filed because a reader who extrapolates Q2 would overstate the beat; it falls inside the bar, so the size is near zero.

findings.finding: Q3 2025's comparison base (PLN 349m revenue, PLN 193.5m net) included the July 2025 PlayStation Plus Extra/Premium deal and the Switch 2/Mac launch tail. Q3 2026 has no such deal found, so the headline will show a steep year-on-year fall.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No recorded instance of a year-on-year-decline headline on a consensus-beating quarter for this name.

findings.why_not_priced: The consensus already embeds the decline (EPS 1.04 vs 1.92). What remains is headline optics in Polish wire copy ('zysk spadł o ~45% r/r', profit down ~45% y/y), which matters on a retail-heavy WIG20 name. Small.
